style_metric_profile.visual_hierarchy: chart or protocol table first, implication rail second, caveat/source always visible
style_metric_profile.source_burden: high; compact source IDs on evidence slides plus editable references when needed
style_metric_profile.footer_posture: source-line with report, cohort, n/r, or data-cut cues

decision.reason: Explicit/workspace preset remains primary; topic-aware atoms and composition grammar supply bounded treatment and rhythm choices.

style_atom_context.strict_json_instruction: Use strict JSON only. Return no markdown, comments, or prose.

primary.description: Move from population and care state through evidence gates to a bounded clinical action.

density.distribution: stage bands with one dominant clinical evidence object

invariant_moves: Identify the patient or cohort state before discussing intervention.
Separate evidence threshold from care recommendation.
Make safety, monitoring, and escalation explicit.
forbidden_moves: Do not imply clinical certainty beyond the cited evidence.
Do not hide contraindications or unresolved safety signals.

title.content_goal: Light clinical opener with one blue/teal status rail and compact context chips.
title.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Title must name the deck object, not a generic category.
Subtitle should lock scope or use context.

comparison.content_goal: Two care paths with decision criteria in a low-contrast center gutter.
comparison.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Verdict must be visible on the slide.

chart.content_goal: Outcome chart with right-side clinical readout and n/r/source footnote.
chart.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Chart needs a written readout, not only bars/lines.

table.content_goal: Protocol table with semantic pass/review/fail fills and short row labels.
table.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Split or summarize if table text would fall below body-size floor.

figure.content_goal: Figure-first evidence panel with interpretation and caveat stack.
data_roles: figure path or generated output id
figure.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Figure must be source-backed or synthetic/starter-labeled.
Caption and interpretation must remain readable.

dashboard.content_goal: Three clinical status bands: cohort, outcome, operational blocker.
dashboard.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Use dashboard only when multiple metrics earn one slide.
Every metric needs a label and context.

decision.content_goal: Recommendation strip framed as clinical action, owner, and evidence confidence.
decision.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Decision slide must make the action inspectable.
Avoid generic next-step prose without owner or trigger.

references.content_goal: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
references.source_posture: Source-line footer with trial/report IDs; full refs table only when needed.
authoring_checks: Move long citations to editable references tables.

normal_workflow_contract.decision_rule: Use the resolved style_execution_plan_v1 as the authoring default. Refine only when the evidence shape or explicit user constraints make a recorded change necessary.
persist_when_used: content_plan.json:narrative_arc or slide_plan variants where topic-fit
do_not_force: Do not use every preferred variant just because it appears in the atom packet.
Do not merge entire page systems from alternative composition grammars.
Do not override explicit user style, brand, source, or accessibility constraints.
Do not copy external slide geometry; atoms are descriptor-only grammar signals.

slides.title: Core message
slides.subtitle: Start from the decision or takeaway
bullets: State the main decision, result, or recommendation first.
Use one evidence object per content slide when data is available.
Keep source-backed claims explicit and traceable to the planning files.
Convert dense prose into a chart, table, figure, or short comparison.
highlights: Alignment and readability are release gates.
QA blocks overlap, overflow, and sparse layouts.
